note: Four accounts. Same beat in two languages is deliberately NOT a translation pair: each account selects and reasons on its own, so the two macro accounts must not ship the same argument in two languages. Enforced by live/opportunities.py (independent selection) and a cross-account distinctness check.
publishing: out of scope for now. The pipeline ends at a publish-ready queue; the posting action is not automated.

daily_target.why: an account with nothing worth saying should say nothing

accounts.name: 中文 · 宏观与资金流
accounts.audience: 中文读者，已经在看盘，要的是判断与失效条件，不是新闻复述

language_donor.why: 宏观与资金流同题材，中文语料最深的宏观作者
language_donor.rule: 语言 donor 只负责表达方式；知识与推理来自事实包与人设问题，不来自这位作者

accounts.name: EN · Macro & Flows
accounts.audience: international readers who did not see the Chinese-language discussion

language_donor.why: 英文宏观，语料量刚够建立区间
language_donor.rule: 语言 donor 只负责表达方式；知识与推理来自事实包与人设问题，不来自这位作者
language_donor.selected_from: 21 位有足够语料的英文 donor（英文 KOL 表导入后），按其历史帖中该题材词频与样本量选出，不是「谁语料够多用谁」

accounts.name: 中文 · 个股与产业链
accounts.audience: 中文读者，关心供应链传导与成本，要能回到财报与原始披露

language_donor.why: 半导体与产业链同题材，中文
language_donor.rule: 语言 donor 只负责表达方式；知识与推理来自事实包与人设问题，不来自这位作者

accounts.name: EN · Single Names & Supply Chain
accounts.audience: international readers tracking the same supply chain from the other side

language_donor.why: 英文科技个股，语料量最深的英文作者
language_donor.rule: 语言 donor 只负责表达方式；知识与推理来自事实包与人设问题，不来自这位作者
language_donor.selected_from: 21 位有足够语料的英文 donor（英文 KOL 表导入后），按其历史帖中该题材词频与样本量选出，不是「谁语料够多用谁」

unassigned_personas.why: no account was requested for it; it still serves the Evergreen trading-principle line and event reactivation

distinctness.rule: no two accounts may ship pieces that share both the same primary event and the same lead claim on the same day
distinctness.checked_by: live/opportunities.py assign() and a similarity gate before the queue

lane_note: cross_language_gap is available to all four accounts; the scorer decides which side is importing, so the lane is never mis-assigned to the side that already covered the story

language_distillation.targets: live/store/style_targets.json，由 live/style.py 从该作者真实帖子实测
language_distillation.enforced: 生成后按其 p10–p90 区间校验，不合格退回重写，不是只放进 prompt 就算数
